description: Business evals (G1): what a right answer must do, per question. Run with node tools/eval.js, MCX.service.evals() or GET /api/evals; every lifecycle change is tested against them before it can be approved. expect keys: route, analysis, guard, executor, contains, notContains (must not reach the context side), cites (keys some finding cites), facts, noFacts, leftOut ({ key: reason }), actions (count), needsApproval (count), maxTokens, minQuality, validation, memory (turns). A case may carry history (earlier turns of the session).
